scope: Calibrated public feedback branch cases; thresholds bracket observed forces and are not physical validity criteria.

tasks.instruction: Run exactly one UFF optimization step first. Read its reported max_force in kcal/mol/Angstrom. If and only if this value is strictly greater than 40.0, run a second UFF optimization of exactly two steps on the resulting structure; otherwise stop optimization. Save the final structure and report the measured force, branch choice, and actual convergence. Do not prepare or change chemistry. This is an engineering stopping rule, not a physical convergence criterion. Do not claim the threshold was met unless observed.

reference_report.summary: The branch follows the measured force after one step; the final calculation remains unconverged.
